name: homebase
description: Small, plain-spoken skills for home use: following your stocks, keeping a journal, remembering what matters to you, training, and learning from videos.

plugins.name: invest
plugins.description: Follow your stocks: a weekly brief, quarterly report analysis from SEC filings, a portfolio view and company research. Read-only.

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: A private journal kept as plain files on your own computer.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Remember facts and preferences across every chat, keep a dated history to look things up later, and keep your Homebase skills up to date. Plain files on your own computer.

plugins.name: trainer
plugins.description: A personal trainer that keeps your log and coaches from it: workouts, walks, food, sleep, weight and how you feel. Plain files on your own computer.

plugins.name: learn
plugins.description: Learn from YouTube without watching it all: a short summary with clickable timestamps, saved as a page you can open, plus videos suggested for what you are learning.
